title: signature
description: A many-sorted specification S = (Sorts, Ops, ar): the purely syntactic skeleton of a theory — which operations a structure must provide, with typed profiles, but no axioms. Adding axioms to a signature yields a theory; an algebraic structure (magma, group, ring) is a model of a signature plus axioms.

sorts.description: a finite set of sort (carrier-type) names

operations.description: a finite set of named operation symbols

arity-function.description: ar : Ω → Sorts* × Sorts assigning each operation a typed profile
